title: Occupied cells lie among visited head positions
statement: Let $(c_j)_{j\in\bbn}$ be a sequence of configurations of a $k$-work-tape Turing machine. Suppose every cell of every work tape is blank in $c_0$, and for each $j$, either $c_{j+1}=c_j$ or $c_{j+1}$ is obtained by applying a single action to $c_j$. If cell $z\in\bbz$ contains a symbol on tape $i$ in $c_t$, then $z$ is one of the head positions of tape $i$ at some time from $0$ through $t$, inclusive.
hypotheses_covered: All work-tape cells are blank at time $0$
Each successive configuration either stays the same or results from applying an action
An integer cell position $z$ contains a symbol on tape $i$ at time $t$
